content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am excited to work together, but I would like to request a few minor changes before signing: - Regarding the relevant clause on scope, the agreement requires accepting extra work without additional pay if it fits within the budget; I propose that any changes or extra work outside the agreed scope be documented in a written change order and billed at standard rates. - Regarding the relevant clause on revisions, the agreement permits 15 rounds of revisions, which is an excessive allowance; I propose limiting this to three rounds of revisions for each deliverable, with additional revisions subject to a separate change order and additional fees. - Regarding the relevant clause on payment terms, the agreement sets payment to Net 60, which delays receiving funds; I propose updating invoices to be payable Net 30. Thank you for your time and understanding, and please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
